about: The splits table (the language lane's engine mechanism SPLITS, 14 October): one target sound heard as two consecutive sounds, per language, at a cost (thousandths). German: espeak writes -er as [ɜ] (or [ɐ]); a learner who sounds the r is heard [r] or [ɾ] with a schwa before or after it (the third run's B, lab/RESULTS-3.md). lab/engine_measure.py converts this list to the configuration's shape once the lane gives it.
